A Standard architectural element must carry either data or functionality, not both.

Back to STX rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

A Standard architectural element must carry either data or functionality, not both. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the The Standard family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STX0001: A Standard architectural element must carry either data or functionality, not both.
public class Student
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public ValueTask Submit() => default;
}

Good code example

// Follows STX0001
public class Student
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
}

internal interface IStudentService
{
    ValueTask<Student> AddStudent(Student newStudent);
}

internal partial class StudentService(IStudentBroker studentBroker)
    : IStudentService
{
    public ValueTask<Student> AddStudent(Student newStudent) => TryCatch(async () =>
    {
        await Validate(newStudent);

        return await studentBroker.InsertStudentAsync(newStudent);
    });
}
